title: X-Ray judge scorecard

ghost_or_ping.note: Official Judge Mode latency proof is judge-latency.json. Populate latency.json with scripts/bench_latency.py when a live stack is available.

honesty_contract: source=hydradb only when HydraDB rows produced the displayed answer or ranking
fixture findings after engine failure keep source=fixture with degraded_reason set
landing-page mock never claims live engine status
mutations require XRAY_WRITE_TOKEN; imports remain opt-in
Repair Ledger overlays are snapshot obligations, not rewritten source exports
limitations: The 75-question corpus is synthetic and ontology-focused, not a blinded real-world incident study.
Ghost findings from live mode score the MSpaths-sampled communication subgraph, not a hidden full-bundle Python ranking labeled as HydraDB.
Identity resolution remains an explicit human workbench; unresolved aliases are excluded from risk scoring.
PlanGraph-style and blinded artifacts are synthetic protocol demos, not multi-org field studies.
